input.title: Two Future Payments
input.request: I can see two future payments of £34.80 to Northmere Heating. Please check whether they are duplicates and remove the duplicate.

events.text: Two future payment lines of £34.80 to Northmere Heating are shown. Their relationship has not been established.
After completing H&V's identity checks, I asked you to escalate this and remove the duplicate. I do not know which line is the duplicate.
I am checking the type and internal reference of each instruction behind the two future lines. I have not cancelled either instruction.
The entries match separate instruction records: one customer standing order and one direct debit mandate. Their types and internal references are distinct.

summary: Mara Ellison, a verified customer on a call, asked the desk to check whether two future £34.80 payments to Northmere Heating were duplicates and to remove the duplicate. The desk's checks found the two lines come from separate instruction records, one a standing order and one a direct debit mandate, so it could not establish that either is a duplicate. Mara also cannot say which line she means, so the desk escalated the case and cancelled nothing. A person still needs to review both lines, decide whether they are duplicates, and confirm with Mara which one to remove before anything is cancelled.
